Gays-Cruising and Cruisingmap both refer to the same neighborhood and woodland, with Cruisingmap showing August–September 2026 dated invitations or planned visits, not eyewitness accounts of completed encounters. Forest access may also be subject to 2026 African swine fever natural-area restrictions.

Check exact street/forest legal boundary and official signs; do not suggest entering closed woods.
